title: Enhanced kerosene selectivity in Fischer-Tropsch synthesis using ceria-coated catalysts
content:

Fischer-Tropsch synthesis emerges as a viable alternative for producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels. In this study, a reference cobalt-based catalyst was modified with ceria to enhance product selectivity towards the kerosene...
